peach: Soft, sweet fruit with a rounded, velvety impression.
lily-of-the-valley: Fresh green flowers with sweetness and a faint lemony edge.
pear: Crisp, delicate fruit with a fresh green quality.
freesia: Light, airy flowers with green sweetness and citrus nuances.
peony: A gentle floral impression with a fresh, rosy softness.
black-pepper: Sharp, lively spice with a fresh woody edge.
apple: Crisp fruit with a fresh, juicy impression.
raspberry: Juicy red berries, balancing sweetness with a tart edge.
magnolia: Creamy white flowers with a bright, fresh quality.
violet-leaves: Cool green leaves with watery and slightly metallic facets.
guaiac-wood: Dense, smoky wood with tobacco and tarry nuances.
ambergris: A complex musky impression with marine, earthy and woody facets. Distinct from an amber accord.
mint: Bracing herbal freshness with a cool, menthol-like impression.
lime: Vivid citrus with a juicy, tart character.
rosemary: Pungent aromatic herbs with camphor and lavender associations.
juniper-berries: Fresh, slightly bitter pine and a recognisable gin-like edge.
tobacco-leaf: Sweet dried leaves, often earthy, haylike or softly smoky.
elemi: Bright resin with lemony, spicy and balsamic facets.
gardenia: A rich, full white-flower impression, often recreated as an accord.
mimosa: Airy floral powder with honeyed warmth and an iris-like softness.
ambrette-seed: Gentle musk with light sweetness and a faint boozy quality.
cinnamon: Warm, sweet spice with a sharp, lively edge.
clary-sage: Sweet herbal notes with amber and fresh tobacco associations.
cypriol-nagarmota: Earthy wood with cedar, vetiver and gently peppery associations.
